name: Hit
description: A basic body slam. Always hits.

name: Bite
description: A big chomp.

name: Scratch
description: Scratches with its claws.

name: Pinch
description: A quick pinch.

name: Peck
description: Pecks with its beak.

name: Goop Throw
description: Throws a glob of goop.

name: Bounce Attack
description: Bounces up and lands on the other monster.

name: Shell Bash
description: Bashes with its hard shell.

name: Sting
description: A sharp sting.

name: Tail Smack
description: Smacks with its tail.

name: Pounce
description: Leaps onto the other monster.

name: Dive Bomb
description: Dives down from the sky.

name: Belly Flop
description: Flops down with its big belly.

name: Burn
description: Burns the other monster. It gets hurt a little for 2 turns.

name: Lava Spit
description: Spits hot lava.

name: Ash Cloud
description: Blows a cloud of hot ash.

name: Splash
description: A big splash of water.

name: Bubble Blast
description: Shoots a stream of bubbles.

name: Dig
description: Hides underground for a turn, then pops up and attacks.

name: Sand Spray
description: Sprays sand.

name: Stomp
description: A heavy stomp.

name: Freeze
description: An icy blast. It might freeze the other monster for a turn.

name: Snowball
description: Throws a snowball.

name: Ice Slap
description: Slaps with an icy flipper.

name: Acorn Toss
description: Throws an acorn.

name: Wing Gust
description: Flaps up a strong wind.

name: Fetch
description: Powers up! Attacks get stronger, up to 2 times.

name: Pinecone Blast
description: Fires a pinecone.

name: Talon Strike
description: Strikes with sharp talons.

name: Tide Crash
description: Crashes down like a wave.

name: Beak Slam
description: Slams with its big beak.

name: Sandstorm
description: Whips up a sandstorm.

name: Desert Charge
description: Charges across the sand.

name: Iceberg Slide
description: Slides in on an iceberg.

name: Icicle Claw
description: Slashes with icy claws.

name: Magma Slam
description: Slams with a fist of magma.

name: Cinder Dive
description: Dives down trailing hot cinders.

name: Eat
description: Takes a bite and heals by half the damage.

name: Lick
description: A big slurpy lick.

name: Slobber
description: Slobbers on the other monster. Its next attack is weaker.

name: Spit
description: Spits at the other monster. Its next attack is weaker.

name: Screech
description: A loud screech. The other monster's next attack is weaker.

name: Sleep
description: Takes a nap to heal. It cannot attack next turn.

name: Popsicle
description: Eats a popsicle and heals a little.

name: Protect the Queen
description: Heals the other monsters on your team.

name: Slash
description: A fast swipe with sharp fins.

name: Tsunami
description: A giant wave crashes down.

name: Shard Shot
description: Shoots sharp crystal shards.

name: Gem Glare
description: A bright flash makes the other monster's next attack weaker.

name: Sparkle Beam
description: A beam of rainbow sparkles.

name: Ember Puff
description: Puffs hot embers that can burn.

name: Flicker Flash
description: A quick flash of flame.

name: Glow Bonk
description: Bonks with its glowing head.

name: Shell Toss
description: Throws a seashell.

name: Moat Splash
description: Splashes water from its moat.

name: Tower Topple
description: Drops a whole tower on the other monster.

name: Tumble Roll
description: Rolls into the other monster.

name: Prickle Poke
description: Pokes with tiny thorns.

name: Hot Splash
description: Splashes hot lava that can burn.

name: Steam Whistle
description: A loud whistle makes the other monster's next attack weaker.

name: Freeze Punch
description: An icy punch that can freeze.

name: Kick
description: A hero kick.

name: Freeze Breath
description: Breathes freezing air that can freeze.

name: Frost Quake
description: Stomps so hard the ground freezes and shakes.

name: Pebble Pelt
description: Throws a handful of pebbles.

name: Moss Hug
description: A soft mossy hug that takes some HP back.

name: Sprout Spin
description: Spins the sprout on its head like a fan.

name: Boulder Bash
description: Rolls its whole mossy boulder body into the other monster.

name: Leaf Flutter
description: A flurry of fluttering leaves.

name: String Snap
description: Snaps its kite string like a whip.

name: Gust Dive
description: Rides the wind up high and dives down.

name: Storm Swoop
description: Swoops down with a howling storm wind.

name: Bubble Pop
description: Pops a big bubble right in its face.

name: Foam Spray
description: Sprays foam in the other monster's eyes, so its next attack is weaker.

name: Bounce Bash
description: Bounces off the ground and bonks the other monster.

name: Bubble Storm
description: A storm of a hundred bubbles.

name: Splinter Shot
description: Shoots little wooden splinters.

name: Seaweed Snare
description: Wraps the other monster in seaweed, so its next attack is weaker.

name: Log Roll
description: Rolls over the other monster like a log.

name: Root Sip
description: Sips water from the other monster and heals.

name: Pot Smash
description: Smashes down with its clay pot.

name: Petal Storm
description: A whirling storm of desert flower petals.

name: Shadow Poke
description: Pokes with the sharp tip of its shadow.

name: Glare Flash
description: Flashes the sun in the other monster's eyes, so its next attack is weaker.

name: Noon Blast
description: A blast of hot midday sunlight.

name: Sun Pillar
description: A pillar of blazing sunlight comes down from the sky.

name: Snow Swirl
description: A swirl of snow from inside its globe. Can freeze.

name: Glass Bonk
description: Bonks with its round glass head.

name: Shake Up
description: Shakes itself and throws snowflakes.

name: Whiteout
description: A blizzard so thick nobody can see. Can freeze.

name: Pom-Pom Bop
description: Bops with its fluffy pom-pom.

name: Yarn Tangle
description: Tangles the other monster in yarn, so its next attack is weaker.

name: Snow Pat
description: Pats a snowball right onto the other monster.

name: Avalanche Flop
description: Flops down like an avalanche.

name: Wax Drip
description: Drips hot wax. Can burn.

name: Wick Whip
description: Whips with its burning wick.

name: Melt Down
description: Melts into a hot puddle and splashes up.

name: Triple Flame
description: All three flames shoot at once.

name: Smoke Puff
description: Puffs smoke in the other monster's face, so its next attack is weaker.

name: Rock Spit
description: Spits a hot rock.

name: Volcano Burst
description: Its top blows off in a giant burst of lava.

name: Magma Fist
description: A punch with a fist of hot magma.

name: Fire Kick
description: A blazing kick.

name: Fire Bite
description: A bite with blazing teeth.

name: Fire Paw
description: A swipe with a burning paw.
